public_proposal.question: Can continuous harmonic-persistence mixtures improve NOAA hourly forecasts?

candidate.hypothesis: Continuous harmonic-persistence mixtures can improve NOAA hourly forecasts in Boston, MA, by combining persistence with harmonic components trained on historical data.
candidate.falsifier: If the MAE does not improve by at least 0.6 meters within 12 days of training, the hypothesis is falsified.

independent_audit.limitations: Four historical station-day NOAA tests; prewritten harmonic model and blending equation, model-generated coefficients, same-model self-critique. Historical observations may have been available during pretraining. Not a pretraining-blind AGI or real-time operational forecast.
